title: Snake dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='snakeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7CFC6A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2FA82F'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- waving tail -->
  <path d='M18 88 C 8 80, 12 70, 22 68 C 32 66, 34 58, 26 52' fill='none' stroke='#2FA82F' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body S-curve -->
  <path d='M26 52 C 40 44, 46 62, 54 56 C 62 50, 58 36, 66 34' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <path d='M26 52 C 40 44, 46 62, 54 56 C 62 50, 58 36, 66 34' fill='none' stroke='#B8F5A0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='2 6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#5FD44A' transform='rotate(-15 72 30)'/>
  <!-- head top shade -->
  <path d='M60 26 Q 72 18 84 24 Q 76 20 66 22 Z' fill='#3AAE2A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='28' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#FFFBD0'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='26' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#FFFBD0'/>
  <ellipse cx='70.5' cy='28' rx='1.4' ry='1.7' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <ellipse cx='80.5' cy='26' rx='1.4' ry='1.7' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M68 35 Q 74 39 81 33' fill='none' stroke='#2A7A22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M84 32 L 90 33 M84 32 L 89 29' fill='none' stroke='#FF5C8A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- musical notes showing dance -->
  <g fill='#FFD34D'>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='22' rx='4' ry='3'/>
    <rect x='36.5' y='10' width='2' height='12'/>
    <path d='M38.5 10 Q 45 12 43 18' fill='none' stroke='#FFD34D' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7CC8FF'>
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='14' rx='3.5' ry='2.6'/>
    <rect x='54' y='4' width='1.8' height='10'/>
  </g>
</svg>
